title: Non-pressure ulcer depth and burn extent
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM code for the ulcer, or for the burn extent (T31) when the note is about a burn (only that code).
note:
Admission Date: 05/12/2026
Discharge Date: 05/24/2026
Reason for Admission: Severe flame burns.

Hospital Course: 
83F pt admitted with extensive flame burns covering 35% of the body surface area. Assessment revealed that 25% of the total area consists of third degree (full thickness) burns. Pt stabilized and managed in burn unit. Fluid resuscitation initiated per Parkland formula. Wound care provided daily. Surgical intervention performed for debridement and skin grafting as planned. Pt tolerated procedures well. Pain managed with IV meds, transitioned to PO. Vitals remained stable throughout stay. Wound appearance improving with minimal signs of infection.

Discharge Diagnoses:
- Flame burns (35% BSA)
- Third degree burns

Discharge Medications:
- Morphine 5mg PO PRN for severe pain
- Oxacillin 1g PO BID
- Acetaminophen 650mg PO every 6 hours PRN

Follow-up:
F/u with burn team in 1 week for wound check and dressing change.

Electronically signed, P. O'Brien, MD, 05/24/2026
explanations: Burns of 30-39% of the body with 20-29% third degree: T31.32 (HCC 385).

distractors.why: 20-29% third degree is documented: the second character after the extent is 2.
